name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-cross-site-events
title: React Cross-site Events
shortDescription: Read-only Microsoft Graph calendar views from bounded SharePoint team-site sources.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework 1.23.2 React 17 web part that aggregates Microsoft 365 group calendarView results, with timezone-safe dates and resilient per-source loading states.

references.description: List occurrences, exceptions, and single instances in a calendar view.
